subject: general
question: Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan Awards in India were instituted in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1954__**.

__
 
• **Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan**__ are both civilian awards of the Republic of India and were instituted on __**2 January 1954**__.
 
• Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian honour and Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian honour.
 
• Both awards are conferred in recognition of exceptional service to the country in any field.
 
• The first Bharat Ratna was awarded to C.V. Raman (physicist), Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan (philosopher), and C. Rajagopalachari (politician).
 
• The first Padma Vibhushan was awarded to Satyendra Nath Bose (physicist), Zakir Hussain (politician), V. K. Krishna Menon (politician), Nand Lal Bose (painter), Jigme Dorji Wangchuk (King of Bhutan), and Balasaheb Gangadhar Kher (politician).
